integrity: Proof is analytic; standard-library rational checker is a finite cross-check, not a proof of the countability or universal quantifiers. Same-model review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only axial interior observation points on a fixed regular simplex, all dimensions d>=3, and perpendicular feet onto supporting affine hyperplanes; a countable exceptional set is not classified. Foot positions may be outside finite facets; stability and nonaxial point dynamics unproved. Historical priority not exhaustively established.
title: Generic absence of finite pedal-shape return for regular simplices in every dimension at least three
